newsitem.title: FRANCE: Iran may have bought Canada wheat - industry sources.
newsitem.headline: Iran may have bought Canada wheat - industry sources.

text.p: Iran on Tuesday may have bought up to 500,000 tonnes of Canadian soft wheat for May/June shipment, European Union grain industry sources said on Wednesday.
But there was no official confirmation of a transaction, they said.
There were no pricing details but European sources said Canada had been aggressively selling its wheat on world markets and Iran had large import requirements for this year.
Grain exporters said it would be hard to confirm the deal as the Canadian Wheat Board was usually secretive about its transactions.
